studies.notes: The entire saved markdown conversion was read, including references and Appendix A. The saved arXiv PDF was checked directly with PyMuPDF. n_randomized records the explicitly printed recruited cohort, not a separately printed randomization-flow total. Random assignment is stated in PDF p. 6, Section 3.3: "After completing the questionnaire, the participants were randomly assigned to one of the three conditions". The abstract (PDF p. 1) reports the experiment N, but does not explicitly identify the analyzed creativity sample. No analyzed participant count is printed for design fixation, fluency, variety, or originality in the methods (PDF pp. 5-7, Sections 3.1-3.5), results (PDF pp. 8-10, Sections 4.1-4.5, Tables 1-4 and Figures 6-9), or Appendix A (PDF p. 18, Table A.1). No participant exclusions or attrition counts are reported. The recruited cohort is therefore not assumed to equal n_analyzed. The paper prints equal allocation and the gender-specific counts preserved above, but no total per arm; these counts were not added and the cohort was not divided to derive arm totals. The screening form contains inferred arm totals, which were not adopted. Sketch removals in PDF p. 12, Section 4.6.2 concern the ancillary sketch/image correlation, not participant exclusions. Sketch, prompt, image, rating and cluster counts, model effective sample sizes, and NASA-TLX degrees of freedom were not used to infer participant counts. Appendix A contains NASA-TLX means and standard errors, with no participant counts. The external protocol is mentioned in PDF p. 4, Section 3.1: "The full study protocol can be found in supplementary material." It is not embedded in the PDF, no file is listed for it in the local supplement manifest, and it has no printed retrieval URL. Retrieval attempts at the ACM article and the University of Melbourne repository named in the citation record both failed because network socket access was denied. The external protocol could not be checked.
